meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show real token usage and estimated savings for the current session, read from the session log. Trigger: /caveman-stats.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实时查看本次会话的用量与省费估算
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你平时用 AI 助手,想知道每次会话的 token 花费。
copy.tagline_en: See real-time token usage and savings for the current session.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI tools and want to track token spend per session.

howto.what: 装上后，输入 /caveman-stats 会读取当前会话日志，立即显示实际 token 用量和预估节省。有估算时还显示规则开销与净节省；若净节省为负，会直说并建议关掉 caveman。
howto.when: 当你在对话中输入 /caveman-stats 命令时触发；命令会拦截本轮，不经模型直接返回统计。

say.note: 命令一发出，立即返回统计数字。
若出现负数，Claude 会解释是开销超过节省，并给出建议。

howto.what_en: Typing /caveman-stats reads the session log and shows actual token usage and estimated savings for the current session. When an estimate exists, it also shows estimated rule overhead and net; if net is negative, it says so plainly and suggests disabling caveman for that workload.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you enter the /caveman-stats command. The command intercepts the turn and returns stats without model involvement.

say_en.note: Shows token usage and savings right away.
Claude explains overhead exceeded savings and suggests action.
Claude cites the per-turn token estimate and env override.
